# Alex Curtis

Alex Curtis is the current Deputy of [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Alex Curtis has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alex-curtis#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 8 with 59.8% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/alex-curtis/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AwbrF4yTEBA)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20250223184833/https://curtis.je/)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=12)

Alex Curtis has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/14/st-clement-deputy-to-stand-again/)\]

## Election History

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8) (3 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**Alex Curtis was elected as Deputy of District 8 in 2022**.
